scripts.dev:api: uv run --project apps/api --directory apps/api uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.lint: turbo run lint && uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api/app apps/api/tests
scripts.typecheck: turbo run typecheck && uv run --project apps/api mypy apps/api/app
scripts.test: turbo run test && uv run --project apps/api pytest apps/api/tests
